title: Hypothetical time to first valid dataset use
method: Synthetic baseline stages are 2+3+4+1=10 business days for discovery, access, semantics and validation. Proposed stages are 1+1+2+1=5; difference=5. These are planning assumptions, not observed results or a causal claim about data mesh.
alt: Hypothetical time to first valid dataset use. Baseline workflow: 10 business days; Proposed pilot: 5 business days; Modeled reduction: 5 business days. Illustrative values.
